For if we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s. —Romans 14:8

..Thru the Bible with Dr. J. Vernon McGee  Leviticus 8:1-13..

Today’s stop on the Bible Bus covers the consecration of the priests. God used imperfect men to serve as a picture of Jesus’ role as living Prophet, Priest, and King. In Leviticus 8, discover how God takes the horizontal, earthly meanings of the Tabernacle and makes them vertical or heavenl

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-with-j-vernon-mcgee/player/leviticus-81-13-1300563.html?type=branded#now-playing

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee   Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

He said, “I am the Light of the world.” This is the highest claim He’s made so far in the Gospel of John. Fact of the matter is one of the definitions of God over in the Epistle of First John is “God is light.” That’s the first definition. God is light. He’s holy, He’s righteous, and He’s just. And the Lord Jesus Christ is light. He’s spiritual light. And all the light that this poor world enjoys physically comes from the sun, and all the spiritual light that this poor world gets comes from Jesus Christ. And just as a little child can have enough sense to get into the presence of light, any sinner today—though he be a fool and a wayfaring man—can come into the presence of Jesus Christ.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/come-into-the-light-1300566.html

https://ttb.org/


...Daily Promises...

But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life. (John 4:14)

Never to be thirsty forever! How glorious this revelation! Ever more shall our soul's desires be quenched. God's spirit shall fill us to overflowing and our rest will be made full. Praise God for His mercy and loving kindness!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Hold on to Him...

Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil; — Hebrews 6:19

Instead of letting the chaos distract you, hold tight to the one who can bring you peace.


https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/hold-on-to-him

...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=VuXS8_GiSianxV7D

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm
